body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one point within 6 units. Until your next turn, creatures cannot benefit from ordinary concealment against you while inside 2 units of that point.

surges.html: Choose one creature or object affected by this Action as the Rite's sympathetic link. The Rite may trigger from that link within 6 units as though it were at the Rite's location.
Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1; when its final Echo resolves, one ally in range becomes Rallied.

rider.title: DIVINATION RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: A creature within 5 units moves into concealment or out of line of sight. Echo: One ally may treat the creature as visible until the end of the current turn.
